versions.heading: PAYMENT
versions.text: 4.2 Invoices are payable within 30 days of the invoice date.

findings.claim: Acme faces catastrophic uncapped liability to BigRetail for Nimbus failures due to SLA mismatch: Nimbus promises 99.5% availability with 10% monthly cap, but Acme must deliver 99.9% to BigRetail with uncapped 10% monthly penalties and immediate termination rights
Contradictory payment terms: Clause 4.2 says 30 days, Schedule A says 15 days - Nimbus can enforce the shorter period and claim earlier default
